BusBuddy

AI-Ready Travel Safety & Journey Intelligence Platform

In DevelopmentPre-launch. The apps are not yet publicly available.

BusBuddy is Thasmai InfoTech’s flagship mobility-safety platform for travellers, families and transport ecosystems. Starting in Mangaluru, Udupi and Dakshina Kannada, BusBuddy combines consent-based journey sharing, ETA, smart alerts, SOS workflows and safe-arrival confirmation across iOS, Android and the web. The long-term platform is designed for family safety, colleges, employers and bus operators through secure APIs, operator integrations and journey intelligence.

The Problem

A Journey Should Not Mean Hours of Not Knowing

People travelling alone by bus often rely on repeated phone calls or WhatsApp messages to reassure family members.

The first release is designed to answer these questions through one journey flow, shared only with the people the traveller chooses.

What families are left wondering

  • Did the traveller actually board?
  • Has the trip started?
  • Is the bus delayed?
  • Is the journey progressing normally?
  • When will they arrive?
  • Have they reached safely?
  • Do they need help?
Journey Flow

How It Is Designed to Work

The first release is built around a single journey, from planning the trip to confirming safe arrival.

  1. 1

    Plan the journey

    Enter the origin, destination and planned departure. Operator and bus details are optional.

  2. 2

    Choose trusted contacts

    Invite the people who should follow this trip. A contact has to accept the invitation before seeing anything.

  3. 3

    Start, and share with consent

    Sharing stays off until the traveller turns it on. Who will see what, and for how long, is shown before the journey starts.

  4. 4

    Stay connected on the way

    Trusted contacts follow journey status, approximate location and ETA, each shown with the time it was last updated.

  5. 5

    Confirm safe arrival

    The traveller marks safe arrival, trusted contacts are notified, and location sharing for the trip ends.

SOS, if it is ever needed

A guarded SOS action with a short cancel window sends the selected trusted contacts a high-priority alert with the time and the permitted location.

BusBuddy is not a replacement for official emergency services.

Audience

Who It Is Being Designed For

Travellers and families

  • Students

    Travel independently while a parent or guardian follows the trip.

  • Parents and guardians

    Know a journey is progressing without calling repeatedly.

  • Solo travellers

    Voluntary, private sharing that ends when the trip does.

  • Senior citizens

    A simple flow with large controls and family-assisted setup.

  • Night and long-distance travellers

    ETA, delay notifications and safe-arrival confirmation.

Institutions and operators

  • Colleges, universities and hostels

    Opt-in visibility for student home travel and college transport.

  • Employers

    Late-shift and shuttle travel with a clear escalation workflow.

  • Bus and travel operators

    Passenger-safety differentiation and service-status communication.

  • Tour operators and care providers

    Assisted pickups, transfers and group travel with family notification.

Privacy by Design

Consent Before Tracking

Location is sensitive. BusBuddy is designed so that the traveller decides what is shared, with whom, and for how long.

  • Off by default

    Location sharing starts only when the traveller turns it on.

  • Bound to the journey

    Sharing is per journey or explicitly time-bound, and ends on safe arrival.

  • Revocable at any time

    Revoking a contact removes their access straight away.

  • Only what is approved

    Trusted contacts see the fields approved for them, and only after accepting an invitation.

  • Approximate first

    Approximate location is used where it is adequate. Exact location is optional.

  • Never stale as live

    Status and location carry their last-update time, and old data is labelled as old.

  • Audited

    Safety-critical events and sensitive access are recorded in an audit log.

  • Not for sale

    Personal location data is not sold.

Not an emergency service

BusBuddy is not a replacement for official emergency services. The SOS workflow alerts the trusted contacts the traveller has selected.

AI after reliability

AI is planned for ETA refinement and delay prediction once the core flow is dependable. It is not used to declare a person unsafe or to escalate an emergency on its own.

Where It Starts

Coastal Karnataka First

BusBuddy starts in coastal Karnataka, where buses carry daily student, commuter and intercity travel between towns such as Mangaluru, Udupi, Manipal, Karkala, Kundapura, Bantwal and Puttur.

Priority pilot corridors (planned)

  • Mangaluru ↔ Udupi
  • Mangaluru ↔ Manipal
  • Mangaluru ↔ Karkala
  • Mangaluru ↔ Kundapura
  • Mangaluru ↔ Bantwal
  • Mangaluru ↔ Puttur
  • Mangaluru ↔ Bengaluru
  • Udupi / Manipal ↔ Bengaluru

Three-Year Direction

A direction rather than a commitment. Each stage depends on what the pilots show.

  1. Year 1

    Prove safety value

    Mangaluru, Udupi and Dakshina Kannada

    • Journey sharing with trusted contacts
    • ETA and safe-arrival confirmation
    • SOS workflow
    • Family dashboard
    • Consent and privacy controls

  2. Year 2

    Build the mobility network

    Karnataka

    • Bus operator integrations
    • College and employer dashboards
    • Service disruption alerts
    • Route history
    • APIs and webhooks

  3. Year 3

    Scale the platform

    Beyond Karnataka

    • Partner and white-label integrations
    • Multimodal journeys
    • AI-assisted ETA
    • Missed-stop detection
    • Enterprise analytics

Pilot With Us

  • Bus operators
